2026-10-06.patch_summary: This patch separates the compression and decompression requests in zswap, allowing them to run concurrently without waiting for each other. This is done by introducing a new struct to hold the separate requests and mutexes for each operation. The change follows a proposal from Sergey Senozhatsky for similar splitting of requests in zram. The patch aims to improve performance by reducing the time spent on compression and decompression, especially when there are multiple tasks competing for CPU resources.
